Case: Admin signs in and lands on the Dashboard
Steps: Open the HIUSA address you were given. > Type 900001 in the box 'School ID / ID Number'. > Type the password in the box 'Password'. > Select 'Sign in'. > Look at the page title and the left menu.
Expected: You land on the Dashboard (the address ends in /dashboard/admin). The menu shows your role as Organization Admin. The page shows either a 'Getting started' card or the 'Administration workspace' tiles.

Case: Adviser account 990002 gets the same menu and pages as an Admin
Steps: Sign in with School ID 990002. > Compare the left menu with the Admin menu in the case above. > Open Members > People. > Open Members > Officer positions and find the Adviser row. > Open Finance > Budgets.
Expected: The menu is the same as the Admin menu (Dashboard, Approvals, Members, Finance, Events and tasks, Voting, Store, Updates, Records, My activity). People, Officer positions and Budgets open. If an Adviser position row exists it says 'SAO managed' and has no edit or delete menu. VERIFY: whether the seed holds an Adviser position row.

Case: Left menu has the right groups, pages and order for an Admin
Steps: Read the left menu from top to bottom. > Open each group to see its pages. > Scroll to the bottom of the menu.
Expected: In order: Dashboard; Approvals; Members (People, Officer positions, Programs and sections); Finance (Budgets, Ledger, Collections and advances, Student accounts, Financial reports, Forecast); Events and tasks (Events, Venue booking, Planning, Tasks, AI delegation, Check-in); Voting (Elections, Results); Store (Inventory, Orders, Claim desk); Updates (Announcements, Feed); Records (Compliance, Grievances, Clearance signing, Audit log); My activity (Vote, Shop, My orders, My receipts, Statement of account). Profile and Study objectives sit at the bottom. No SAO, Department Head or student-only pages are listed.

Case: Reach a page from the menu on a phone
Steps: Tap 'Open menu' at the top. > Tap the group 'Events and tasks'. > Tap 'Events'. > Scroll down and sideways on the Events page.
Expected: The menu opens as a drawer, the group opens, and the Events page loads with the title Events. The page does not scroll sideways and every button can be tapped.

Case: Summary cards show counts and open the right page
Steps: On the Dashboard read the four cards: Pending Orders, Approval Requests, Pending Tasks, New Announcements. > Select 'Pending Orders'. > Go back and select 'Approval Requests'. > Go back and select 'Pending Tasks'. > Go back and select 'New Announcements'.
Expected: Each card shows a number. Pending Orders opens Store > Orders. Approval Requests opens Approvals. Pending Tasks opens Events and tasks > Tasks. New Announcements opens Updates > Feed.

Case: A brand new organization sees the first-run message and the Getting started steps
Steps: Sign in as 990032. > Read the middle of the Dashboard. > Find the 'Getting started' card and read its steps. > Select the button 'Plan your first event'.
Expected: The Dashboard says 'Nothing has happened here yet' and offers 'Plan your first event'. The Getting started card lists steps such as 'Set up your officer positions', 'Add your members', 'Set up programs and sections', 'Propose your first budget' and 'Plan your first event', each with a button. The button opens Events and tasks > Events.

Case: A Getting started step is ticked after the work is done
Steps: Open the Dashboard and note the progress bar on Getting started. > Select the step 'Set up your officer positions'. > Add one position (see the Officer positions cases) and save. > Return to the Dashboard.
Expected: The step 'Set up your officer positions' no longer appears as undone and the progress bar has moved up by one step.

Case: Financial status chart changes with the period
Steps: On the Dashboard find the card 'Financial status'. > Change the 'Financial status period' to 3 months, then 6 months, then 12 months. > If no money was recorded, read the message under the chart. > Select 'Open ledger'.
Expected: The chart redraws for each period. With no entries it says 'No ledger transactions in this period.' and offers 'Propose a budget'. 'Open ledger' opens Finance > Ledger.

Case: Latest announcements panel and its three buttons
Steps: On the Dashboard find the 'Announcements' panel with the heading 'Latest updates'. > Select 'New announcement'. > Go back and select 'Manage announcements'. > Go back and select 'View Feed'.
Expected: The panel lists published announcements, or says 'No published announcements yet.' The three buttons open the new announcement form, the Announcements page and the Feed.

Case: Admin cannot open SAO pages by typing the address
Steps: In the address bar type the address of your site followed by /dashboard/super-admin and press Enter. > Try /dashboard/super-admin/organizations. > Try /dashboard/super-admin/compliance.
Expected: No SAO page or SAO data is shown. You are sent to a page you may use (normally your own Dashboard). VERIFY: the exact page you land on.

Case: Admin cannot open Department Head, officer-only or student-only pages by typing the address
Steps: Type /dashboard/department-head/approvals after the site address and press Enter. > Type /dashboard/tasks/assigned-tasks (an officer page). > Type /dashboard/elections/manage-voters (an officer page). > Type /dashboard/my-grievances (a student page). > Open Voting > Elections, open an election and select the step 'Voters'.
Expected: None of the typed pages opens for an Admin and you are sent to a page you may use. VERIFY: the exact page you land on. The 'Voters' step inside the election workspace does open a voter list with turnout.

Case: Signed-out visitor is sent to the sign-in page
Steps: Select your name at the top right and sign out. > Type /dashboard/admin/users after the site address and press Enter. > Type /dashboard/finance/financial-ledger and press Enter.
Expected: You see 'Sign in to HIUSA' each time. No Admin page content is shown.

Case: A session that ended elsewhere sends you to sign in
Steps: Open HIUSA in two browser tabs, both signed in as 900001. > In tab 2 sign out. > Go back to tab 1 and select Members > People.
Expected: Tab 1 shows no data and takes you to the sign-in page instead of a broken page or a crash.

Case: People page shows summary cards, the table and 10 users per page
Steps: Open Members > People. > Read the cards: Total users, Students, Admins, Super admins. > Read the table headings. > Count the rows on the first page.
Expected: Cards show counts. Table columns are School ID, Name, Role, Program / Major, Year Level, Section, Status, Actions. At most 10 rows show and a page control sits under the table. The Filtered user distribution chart is visible.

Case: Search finds a user by name, school ID, program or email
Steps: Open Members > People. > In 'Search name, school ID, program, or email' type 2100142. > Wait a moment and read the table. > Clear the box and type part of a last name. > Type zzzzzz in the search box.
Expected: The list narrows to matching users and the result count updates (for example 1 user). Clearing the box shows everyone again. A search with no match shows 'No users found.' and 0 users, with no error.

Case: Filter users by role and account status
Steps: Open Members > People. > Choose 'Student' in the first dropdown (All roles). > Choose 'Active' in 'Filter by account status'. > Change the status to 'Disabled'. > Use the Clear option on the filter chips.
Expected: Only matching users show each time. A chip for each active filter appears. Clear returns to all users and the first page.

Case: Filter users by program, year level and section
Steps: Open Members > People. > Choose a program in 'Filter by program'. > Choose '1st Year' in 'Filter by year level'. > Open 'Filter by section' and read the options.
Expected: The list shows only students of that program and year. The section list shows only sections of that program and year. Changing the program resets the section.

Case: Sort users and change pages
Steps: Open Members > People. > Open 'Sort users' and choose 'School ID'. > Choose 'Newest accounts'. > Select the next page in the page control. > Type a name in the search box.
Expected: The rows reorder for each choice. Page 2 shows the remaining users. After a search the list goes back to page 1.

Case: Create a student account
Steps: Open Members > People and select 'New User'. > Fill School ID, Email, First Name and Last Name. > Leave Role as Student and choose a Course / Program, Year Level and Section. > Type a Password and the same text in Confirm Password (at least 8 characters). > Select 'Create User'.
Expected: The dialog closes with the message 'User account created.' The student appears in the table as Active with the program, year and section you chose.

Case: Create user form: dependent dropdowns and the position field
Steps: Select 'New User'. > Note the Year Level and Section boxes before choosing a program. > Choose a Course / Program, then a Year Level, then open Section. > Change Role to 'SBO Officer' and look for 'Organization Position'. > Change Role back to 'Student'.
Expected: Year Level stays disabled until a program is chosen and Section stays disabled until a year is chosen. The Section list shows only sections of that program and year. 'Organization Position' appears for SBO Officer and Admin only and disappears for Student.

Case: Create user: required fields and a student without a program
Steps: Select 'New User'. > Leave everything empty and select 'Create User'. > Fill every required field but leave Course / Program empty for a Student. > Select 'Create User'.
Expected: The browser asks for the empty required fields (marked with *). With no program the form says 'Choose a course/program for this student.' No account is created.

Case: Create user: duplicate school ID or email is refused
Steps: Select 'New User'. > Type School ID 2100142 (already used) with a new email and a valid password. > Select 'Create User'. > Change the School ID to a new number and use the email of another user in your organization. > Select 'Create User' again.
Expected: Each attempt stays open and shows a red message under the field (for example that the school ID or email is already taken). VERIFY: exact wording. No second account is created.

Case: Create user: password rules and bad values
Steps: Select 'New User' and fill all required fields. > Type a Password of 5 characters and the same in Confirm Password, then select 'Create User'. > Type a valid Password and a different text in Confirm Password, then select 'Create User'. > Put letters in Contact Number and select 'Create User'. > Type 123456789 (nine digits) as School ID and select 'Create User'.
Expected: Each attempt is refused with a message under the field: the password must be at least 8 characters, the confirmation must match, the contact number may only hold digits, + - ( ) and spaces, and the School ID may hold at most 8 digits. VERIFY: exact wording.

Case: Create an SBO Officer with an organization position
Steps: Select 'New User'. > Set Role to 'SBO Officer'. > Open 'Organization Position' and choose a position. > Fill the other required fields and select 'Create User'.
Expected: The account is created and shows Role SBO Officer. The View profile dialog shows the position under 'Organization position'. Only active positions are in the list, and 'Adviser' is never offered.

Case: Admin cannot create a Department Head account
Steps: Select 'New User'. > Fill all required fields. > Set Role to 'Department Head'. > Select 'Create User'.
Expected: The account is refused with a message that the role is not valid. Only the SAO creates Department Heads. No account is created.

Case: Profile photo must be an image under 2 MB
Steps: Select 'New User' and fill the required fields. > In 'Profile photo (optional)' choose the PDF file. > Select 'Create User'. > Choose the large image instead and select 'Create User' again.
Expected: Each attempt shows 'Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image up to 2 MB.' and nothing is created. A small JPEG or PNG is accepted.

Case: Edit a student account
Steps: Open Members > People and open the row menu (three dots) of a student. > Select 'Edit user'. > Try to type in the School ID box. > Change the Last Name and the Section. > Select 'Save Changes'.
Expected: School ID is greyed out and cannot be changed. The dialog closes with 'User account updated.' and the table shows the new values.

Case: Edit: an email used by someone else is refused
Steps: Open the row menu of a student and select 'Edit user'. > Replace the email with the email of another student in your organization. > Select 'Save Changes'.
Expected: The dialog stays open with a red message that the email is already taken. The old email is kept.

Case: Admin accounts cannot be edited, deactivated or deleted by an Admin
Steps: Open Members > People and choose 'Admin' in the role dropdown. > Open the row menu of 900002. > Read every item in the menu. > Search 990002 (the Adviser) and read the items in its row menu.
Expected: The menus offer View profile and fingerprint items but no 'Edit user', 'Deactivate account' or 'Delete profile'. Only the SAO manages Admin and Adviser accounts.

Case: An Admin cannot delete or deactivate their own account
Steps: Open Members > People and search 900001. > Open the row menu of your own row. > Look for 'Delete profile' and 'Deactivate account'.
Expected: Your own row offers no 'Delete profile' and no 'Deactivate account'. If the request is forced the system refuses with 'You cannot delete your own account.'

Case: Deactivate a student (sign-in is refused), then reactivate
Steps: Open the row menu of the test student and select 'Deactivate account', then 'Deactivate' in 'Deactivate User'. > Read the message and the Status column. > In a private window try to sign in as that student. > Back in People open the row menu and select 'Reactivate account', then 'Reactivate' in 'Reactivate User'. > Read the message and the Status column.
Expected: After deactivating the message reads '<name> was deactivated.', Status shows Inactive and the student sees 'This account cannot sign in right now. Contact your organization admin for help.' After reactivating the message reads '<name> was reactivated.' and Status shows Active. The dialog warns the student may still need to reset a password.

Case: Delete an organization profile needs the school ID typed
Steps: Open the row menu of the test student and select 'Delete profile'. > Read the dialog 'Delete organization profile'. > Try to confirm without typing anything. > Type the student's school ID and select 'Delete profile'.
Expected: The confirm button stays off until the exact school ID is typed. After deleting the message reads '<name> had their organization profile removed.' and the row is gone.

Case: Delete is blocked when the student has linked records
Steps: Open the row menu of that student and select 'Delete profile'. > Type the school ID and confirm. > Read the red message on the page.
Expected: The student is not deleted. The page shows a message such as 'Unable to delete this user because linked records may still exist.' VERIFY: exact wording and whether the profile is removed or kept.

Case: View profile shows details and the live student debt summary
Steps: Open the row menu of a student and select 'View profile'. > Read the details grid. > Scroll to 'Live Student Debt Summary'. > Close the dialog.
Expected: The 'User Profile' dialog shows email, contact number, role, status, department, program, year, major, section and organization position. The debt summary shows Invoice balance, Reserved merchandise and Total outstanding with 'Financially cleared' or 'Pending clearance'.

Case: Export the user list to CSV
Steps: Open Members > People. > Choose 'Student' in the role dropdown. > Select 'Export'. > Open the downloaded file.
Expected: A file named user-register-<date>.csv downloads with the columns School ID, Last Name, First Name, Email, Role, Position, Department, Program, Major, Year Level, Section, Account Status, Created At, Updated At, listing every student, not just the first page. Export is greyed out when no user matches.

Case: Import members from a CSV file (check first, then import)
Steps: Open Members > People and select 'Import'. > In the 'Import members' panel select 'Download template' and compare it with your file. > Choose your file in 'CSV file' and select 'Check file'. > Read the green message, then select 'Import 2 members'.
Expected: The check says 'All 2 rows are ready to import.' After importing the toast reads '2 member accounts created' with the note that they set a password with Forgot password. Both rows appear in the table.

Case: Import shows every bad row and imports nothing
Steps: Open the 'Import members' panel. > Choose the file and select 'Check file'. > Read the red message and the list of rows. > Fix nothing and look at the table behind the panel.
Expected: The panel says '2 of 3 rows need fixing. Nothing has been imported; correct the file and check it again.' Each bad row is listed with its row number and reason. No new user appears.

Case: Import: wrong header, empty file, Admin role and file limits
Steps: Open the 'Import members' panel and check the file without the email column. > Check the header-only file. > Check the file with an Admin row. > Try the .pdf file.
Expected: Messages: 'The first row must name the columns, including school_id, first_name, last_name, email and role.'; 'The file has no member rows under its header.'; the Admin row is listed as an error because admin accounts are added one at a time; the .pdf is refused. Nothing is imported. Note: the panel text says Department Head can be imported but the system refuses that role. VERIFY.

Case: A member created or imported by an Admin must set a new password at first sign-in
Steps: Sign out. > Sign in as the new student with the password you set. > Look at the screen you get. > Fill 'Current password', 'New password' and 'Confirm new password' and save.
Expected: The student sees 'Choose a new password' and no other page opens until the change is saved. After saving the student reaches their home page.

Case: Add an existing user to the organization
Steps: Open Members > People and select 'Add existing user'. > Read the dialog 'Add existing user' and choose the destination organization. > Search a name, school ID or email. > Choose a user and a role, then select 'Add user'.
Expected: Only eligible users of the same college who are not yet members are listed, or the dialog says 'No eligible users found in this college.' After adding, the toast reads 'User added to the organization.' The role list does not offer Admin to an Admin. VERIFY: result on the seed data.

Case: Manage a user's organization profiles
Steps: Open the row menu of a student and select 'Manage profiles'. > Read the dialog 'Manage user profiles'. > Look at the 'Delete profile' button of a profile that cannot be removed.
Expected: The dialog lists the profile(s) with organization, role, status and 'Primary profile' or 'Additional profile'. A profile that cannot be deleted has the button greyed out with the reason shown.

Case: Enroll a fingerprint (needs the DigitalPersona reader)
Steps: Open the row menu of a student and select 'Enroll fingerprint'. > Read the scanner status in the dialog 'Enroll Fingerprint'. > Tick the consent box 'I confirm the user consented to biometric enrollment...'. > Select 'Start 4-Scan Enrollment' and scan the same finger four times.
Expected: Without a reader the Start button stays off and the scanner shows not connected. With a reader and consent, the progress counts 0 to 4 and the toast reads 'Fingerprint enrollment completed...' The row then shows a fingerprint icon.

Case: Other organizations' members are not visible
Steps: Open Members > People. > Search 2100142 (a PSITS-CCS student). > Search 2400118 (a FES-CTE student). > Read the total on the cards.
Expected: Both searches show 'No users found.' The list holds only JPIA-CBE members.

Case: People page works on a phone
Steps: Open Members > People. > Read one user card. > Tap the three-dot button on a card. > Tap 'View profile'.
Expected: Users show as cards with name, school ID, role, status, program, year and section. The action menu opens fully on screen and the profile dialog fits the screen.

Case: Officer positions list, search and role filter
Steps: Open Members > Officer positions. > Read the table headings. > Type part of a title in 'Search title or responsibilities...'. > Choose 'Admin' in 'Filter positions by account role'. > Open page 2 with the page control if it exists.
Expected: Columns are Position, Account Role, Responsibilities, Status, Actions, with 10 rows per page. The search and role filter narrow the list. A filter with no match shows 'No positions match the current filters.'

Case: Add an SBO Officer position
Steps: Select 'Add Position'. > Leave 'Assignable account role *' as Admin, then change it to 'SBO Officer'. > Type a 'Position title *', for example Public Relations Officer. > Type some Responsibilities. > Select 'Save Position'.
Expected: The toast reads 'Position created successfully.' and the position appears as Active in the list. It is now offered in New User when the role is SBO Officer.

Case: Add an Admin position from the list or with Other position
Steps: Select 'Add Position' with role Admin. > Open 'Position title *' and read the choices. > Choose 'Other position...'. > Type 'Executive Secretary' in 'Other position title *'. > Select 'Save Position'.
Expected: The list holds Choose a title, Adviser (SAO only, greyed), President, Secretary, Treasurer, Auditor, Chief of Developer and Other position... The custom title saves with 'Position created successfully.'

Case: Position title rules: too short, duplicate, and the reserved Adviser title
Steps: Select 'Add Position', choose role SBO Officer and type a single letter as the title, then select 'Save Position'. > Type a title that already exists for SBO Officer and save. > Choose role Admin, 'Other position...' and type Adviser, then save.
Expected: Messages: 'Position title must contain at least 2 characters.'; a message that the title is already taken; and 'The Adviser position is assigned only by the Student Affairs Office.' VERIFY: exact wording of the duplicate message. Nothing is created.

Case: Edit a position and make it unavailable
Steps: Open the row menu of your position and select 'Edit position'. > Change the Responsibilities text. > Untick 'Available for assignment'. > Select 'Save Position'. > Open Members > People > New User with role SBO Officer and read the position list.
Expected: The toast reads 'Position updated successfully.' and the row shows Inactive. The inactive position is no longer offered in New User.

Case: Delete a position needs its title typed
Steps: Open the row menu of the position and select 'Delete position'. > Read the dialog 'Delete Position'. > Type the position title and select 'Delete Position'.
Expected: The toast reads '<title> was deleted. Assigned users were safely unassigned.' The row is gone and the officer now has no position.

Case: The Adviser position cannot be changed by an Admin
Steps: Open Members > Officer positions. > Find the row 'Adviser' for account role Admin. > Look at the Actions column.
Expected: The Actions column says 'SAO managed' and there is no edit or delete menu.

Case: Add a program with block sections
Steps: Open Members > Programs and sections. > Read the box 'Department'. > Type a name in 'Course / Program', for example BS Accountancy. > Set 'Years in this program' to 4 and the '1st Year sections' to 2. > Select 'Add Program'.
Expected: The message reads 'Program and its required Non Block sections were created.' The program appears under 'Configured programs' with block sections A, B and a Non Block section for each year.

Case: Program form limits: empty name, duplicate name, years and section counts
Steps: Leave 'Course / Program' empty and look at 'Add Program'. > Type a name that already exists and select 'Add Program'. > Set 'Years in this program' to 9, then to 0. > Type 30 in one 'sections' box and select 'Add Program'.
Expected: Add Program stays off with an empty name. A duplicate name is refused with a red message. Years are held between 1 and 8. More than 26 sections for a year is refused. VERIFY: exact wording.

Case: Edit a program
Steps: Select the pencil button 'Edit <program name>'. > Change the name and add one section to 1st Year. > Read the amber note in the dialog. > Select 'Save Changes'.
Expected: The dialog 'Edit Program' warns that a section cannot be removed while accounts are assigned to it. The message reads 'Program and section settings were updated.' and the list shows the new data.

Case: A program with assigned users cannot be deleted
Steps: Select the trash button 'Delete BS Information Technology' (a program with students). > Read the dialog 'Delete program?'. > Select 'Delete Program'.
Expected: The program stays. The page shows 'Cannot delete this program while N user account(s) are assigned to it.'

Case: Delete a program nobody uses
Steps: Select the trash button for your program. > Read the dialog 'Delete program?'. > Select 'Delete Program'.
Expected: The message reads 'Program and its sections were deleted.' and it leaves the list.

Case: Import a class list: preview, apply, temporary passwords
Steps: In the box 'Import class list' select 'Download CSV template' and compare. > Choose your file in 'Choose class list' and select 'Preview'. > Read the counts: New account, Update, Unchanged, Invalid, Duplicate. > Select 'Confirm and apply 2 rows'. > In the amber box 'Temporary passwords' select 'Download temporary passwords (CSV)', then 'Dismiss'.
Expected: The preview lists each row with a Result and a reason for the invalid one ('Choose a configured program, year number, and section for that year.'). After applying, the message reads 'Import complete: 1 created, 1 updated, 0 unchanged, 1 invalid, 0 duplicate.' The CSV holds school_id, name, temporary_password. The passwords cannot be shown again after Dismiss.

Case: Class list: nothing to apply, wrong file
Steps: Choose a class list where every row is invalid or unchanged and select 'Preview'. > Look at the apply button. > Choose a file that is not CSV or is larger than 2 MB and select 'Preview'.
Expected: The button 'Confirm and apply 0 rows' stays off when no row is new or changed. A wrong or too large file shows a red message and no preview.

Case: A student created by class list import must change the temporary password
Steps: Sign out. > Sign in with the new student's school ID and temporary password. > Read the screen. > Set a new password and save.
Expected: A screen asks for a new password and nothing else opens until it is saved. After saving the student reaches their home.

Case: With no program configured, a student cannot be created
Steps: Open Members > Programs and sections and delete the one configured program (Delete Program). > Read the 'Configured programs' area. > Open Members > People and select 'New User' with Role Student. > Read the hint under 'Course / Program' and try 'Create User' with the other fields filled. > Close the form. > Add the program again with 'Add Program'.
Expected: The list says 'No programs have been configured yet.' The New User form says 'Configure a program in Programs & Sections first.' and the student is refused with 'Configure a course/program before creating a student.' After step 6 the program is back.

Case: Events page shows the list, counts and the academic period
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Events. > Read the four counts: Total Events, Upcoming, Completed, Total Tasks. > Read the table headings. > Read the 'Academic period' box.
Expected: The title is Events and the button 'New event' is the main button. Table columns: Event, Organizer, Schedule, Venue, Attendance, Tasks, Status, Budget Status, Actions. Each row shows a stage line such as 'Waiting for Department Head'. The period box defaults to 'Active period'.

Case: Propose an event (the main Admin journey)
Steps: Open Events and tasks > Events and select 'New event'. > Type an 'Event Name *'. > Set 'Start Date *', 'Start Time *', 'End Date' and 'End Time' inside the active semester. > Under 'Venue type' keep 'On campus' and choose a venue in 'SAO venue'. > Select 'Submit proposal'.
Expected: The form closes and the 'Event details' window opens with the event title and an 'Event progress' stepper. The current step is Department Head approval and the text says 'Waiting for Department Head approval'. The event shows in the list with status planning.

Case: Event form: required fields and end before start
Steps: Select 'New event'. > Look at 'Submit proposal' with an empty Event Name. > Fill the name, start date and start time. Leave the end date and end time empty. > Set an end date and time earlier than the start and select 'Submit proposal'.
Expected: The Submit proposal button is off until Event Name, Start Date, Start Time, End Date and End Time are filled. An end before the start is refused with a red message under the form (the end time must be after the start time). VERIFY: exact wording. No event is created.

Case: Event dates must be inside the active semester
Steps: Select 'New event'. > Fill the name and a venue. > Pick a start date and end date outside the active semester (for example one year later). > Select 'Submit proposal'.
Expected: The proposal is refused with 'Event dates must fall within the active academic semester.' and no event is created.

Case: Venue rules: on-campus needs a venue, off-campus needs a location
Steps: Select 'New event' and fill the required fields. > Keep 'On campus' and leave 'SAO venue' on 'Choose a venue', then select 'Submit proposal'. > Change 'Venue type' to 'Off campus' and leave 'Off-campus location' empty, then select 'Submit proposal'. > Type a location and submit again.
Expected: The first two attempts are refused with 'Choose an active SAO on-campus venue.' and 'Enter the off-campus location.' The third works.

Case: Event that needs a budget: notes are required and the threshold cannot exceed the budget
Steps: Select 'New event' and fill the required fields. > Tick 'Requires budget allocation' and look at Submit proposal. > Type notes in 'Budget Requirements / Notes'. > Type Proposed Budget 1000 and Warning Threshold 2000, then select 'Submit proposal'. > Change the threshold to 500 and submit again.
Expected: Submit proposal stays off while the notes are empty. A threshold above the proposed budget is refused with 'The budget warning threshold cannot exceed the proposed budget.' With 500 the event is created.

Case: A proposed budget on the event creates a linked budget request
Steps: Propose an event with 'Requires budget allocation' ticked, notes, Proposed Budget 5000 and Warning Threshold 1000. > Open Finance > Budgets. > Find the budget named after the event.
Expected: A budget titled '<event name> Proposed Budget' exists with Allocated 5,000.00, linked to the event, waiting for Department Head approval. The Department Head sees a separate approval row for the budget.

Case: Event details window: stepper, schedule, tasks and attendance
Steps: In the list open the row menu of an event and select 'View event'. > Read the 'Event progress' stepper and the line under it. > Read Schedule, Location, Preparation progress and Attendance Summary. > Read 'Linked Budget Status'. > Close with the X button.
Expected: The window shows the stage names (Proposal, Requirements, Approval, Funding, Prepare, Run, Report) with the current step marked, one next-step sentence, the details and the linked budget status. The same stage text appears on the list row.

Case: Submit the SAO event files
Steps: Propose an event, or open one that says 'SAO files needed'. > In the window find 'SAO event requirements'. > Choose one PDF for each listed item. > Select 'Submit event files to SAO'.
Expected: The files are listed with a View button and the section shows a review line. The stage moves on to waiting for the SAO (after the Department Head has approved). If the SAO has defined no requirements, the section says 'SAO has not listed any file requirements.'

Case: SAO event files: non-PDF or missing file, and a second submission
Steps: Open an event that needs SAO files. > Choose a .docx file for a required item and submit. > Leave a required item empty and submit. > Submit a complete set, then try to submit again.
Expected: A non-PDF file and a missing required item are refused ( 'Upload a PDF for every required SAO item.' or a file type message). After a complete submission the upload form is hidden; a repeated send is refused with 'This event has already been submitted.'

Case: Edit an event
Steps: Open the row menu of a planning event and select 'Edit event'. > Change the Event Name and Description. > Select 'Save Changes'. > Read the list row.
Expected: The window titled 'Edit event' saves and the new name shows in the list. A material change to an event that was already approved sends it back to planning and asks the Department Head again.

Case: A completed event or one with attendance cannot be edited
Steps: Open the row menu of that event and select 'Edit event'. > Change the Event Name. > Select 'Save Changes'.
